name: Complete the first learning module
steps: Reveal the key idea and advance through every lesson
expected: Module 1 is marked completed, XP increases, and the completed state remains after refresh.

name: Respect module locking on mobile
steps: Open the learning path on a mobile viewport
expected: Module 2 is locked before Module 1 is complete and becomes available afterward.

name: Complete a project module
expected: Module 6 becomes completed and the learner receives its project XP reward.

name: Reset saved quest progress
expected: XP and completed-module progress return to their initial state.
